title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
read_level: full main text (pdftotext of v1); appendices skimmed (Table 11 cost, prompts, artifact notes)
why_wsp: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 write programs that construct ranked update directions for the cross-attention K/V weights of Stable Diffusion 1.4 for concept edits; a shared CMA-ES fitter picks coefficients; a second program is written after a probe record (score-guided rewrite).
editor: GPT-6 Astra (gpt-6-astra) and Claude Opus 5.5; Gemini wrote fresh evaluation prompts; Qwen3.8-27B primary VLM judge
target: Stable Diffusion 1.4: key and value projections of the 16 cross-attention layers (32 matrices); parameter count not stated
interface: code/tensor tools (build_directions(ctx) program returning up to 8 ranked directions + protection prompts) combined with a numerical solver (CMA-ES over coefficients)
loop: one-shot (U2) and closed-loop with feedback (U3: one rewrite after a probe record of scores and contact sheets)

headline_results.claim: Preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over strong baseline
headline_results.quote: The preregistered primary method shows no advantage over the strong controls. U3-Opus − U1b is -0.3 [-6.2, +5.9] on native joint efficacy

headline_results.claim: One-shot Astra programs raise fresh-scene joint success (exploratory)
headline_results.quote: U2-Astra − U1b is +10.0 [+4.7, +15.4] on fresh-scene joint success, with no detectable difference in CLIP generality (-0.6 [-7.3, +6.4]

headline_results.claim: Exploratory gain does not survive Holm over all cells
headline_results.quote: BH-adjusted across all 288 contrasts p = 0.007, Holm within its endpoint 0.051 (at the boundary), and it does not survive Holm over all cells (0.343).

headline_results.claim: Score-guided rewrite raises CLIP but lowers joint success (Astra)
headline_results.quote: For Astra, rewriting raises fresh-scene CLIP relative match by +6.2 [+1.3, +11.6] while changing joint success by -9.7 [-16.6, -2.9].
For Opus, rewriting changes CLIP generality by +17.6 [+5.4, +31.9]; its joint success changes by +0.4 [-6.8, +7.5]
Every one-shot Astra program builds an SVD basis from text states and projects its update off it (24/24) ... No one-shot Opus program does either (0/24 and 0/24)

headline_results.claim: Requiring subject presence attenuates CLIP advantage between conventional editors
headline_results.quote: Its CLIP generality advantage, +21.4 [+14.9, +28.6], is attenuated by 21.7 [13.5, 30.6] once subject presence is required

cost.quote: astra 807,486 in / 575,707 out (51 calls); opus 898,858 in / 375,509 out (78 calls)
Whole main-comparison run: 19.5 wall-clock hours on 8 GPUs.

baselines_and_controls: TIME, UCE, UCE+P (published closed-form editors); U1b shared-panel hand-written baseline (TIME extended, same fitter); RS budget-matched random search over conventional closed-form edits; unedited model drawing target prompt as reference; five additional VLM evaluators; two human raters
runs_and_variance: 24 TIMED test edits, 12 seeds per prompt, "one program per edit and model, with a single rewrite" (Scope); paired bootstrap intervals (50,000 resamples); Holm and BH adjustments over 288 contrasts
robustness_of_edits: fresh-scene prompts written after units frozen; near-neighbour negatives for specificity; not tested under fine-tuning or other perturbations
verification: statistical (paired bootstrap, sign-flip randomisation, multiple-comparison adjustment); program invariant D_j H = 0 holds by construction (structure coded from syntax trees, "not a runtime verification")
memorization_vs_reasoning: n/a; programs were written with TIME's objective and closed form in the prompt; null-space preservation has precedents (SPEED, ACE)
limitations_stated: Scope limited to SD 1.4, TIMED, one primary VLM judge, one program per edit and model, single rewrite round; no comparison against SPEED or ACE; construction gain not attributed to an individual program component; rewrite effect not separable from the CLIP-guided fitting that follows; U1b panel contains LLM-proposed prompts.
code_or_data: artifacts and preregistration "will be released"; none found
cites_or_builds_on: Li et al. 2026 (reusable editors from experimental feedback)
notes_for_survey: Separates program construction from score-guided revision in a WSP pipeline with strong shared-component controls; the preregistered method shows no advantage, an exploratory one-shot Astra gain appears on a VLM endpoint only. Documents proxy over-optimisation: CLIP-guided rewriting raises CLIP while subject presence and joint success fall.
